messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nThe Link to existing claim button is broken, stopping users from linking a claim. This prevents staff from alerting the system when a matching incident already exists, leading to duplicate claims that must be manually linked, which delays payments and reporting [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].\n\n## Who is affected\n- Three accounts are affected, representing a total ARR of 960000.0 GBP [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca][i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n- Selsby Motor (ARR 190000.0 GBP) has reported the issue twice via session recordings [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca].\n- Tarnholt Drive Cover has reported related workflow problems via a support ticket [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].\n- Ravensgill Insurance has also reported the issue via a session recording [i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n\n## Evidence\n- There are 4 total mentions of this problem from 3 accounts [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5][i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n- The issue has been reported via 2 routes: 3 mentions from sessions and 1 mention from support [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5][i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n- Session recordings show users clicking the Link to existing claim button and the action being dead [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca][i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n- A support report states that the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake, resulting in duplicate claims that must be manually linked after the fact, which delays payments and reporting [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].\n- There has been 1 renewal in the last 90 days [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:89daa1820fc543ca].\n\n## Why now\n- The first reports from Selsby Motor and Ravensgill Insurance occurred on 2026-09-04 [i:85a6dd27b3ce1a1e][i:95caadb2b08c2b23].\n- Selsby Motor reported the issue again on 2026-09-18 [i:89daa1820fc543ca].\n- The most recent report was on 2026-10-25, indicating the problem is ongoing and causing operational delays [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "date": "2026-09-04T08:05:00Z",
   "id": "85a6dd27b3ce1a1e",
   "quote": "Claims: click \"Link to existing claim\", dead x1 ... Claims: click \"Next\"",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "date": "2026-09-18T09:38:00Z",
   "id": "89daa1820fc543ca",
   "quote": "Claims: click \"Link to existing claim\", dead x1",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "account": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
   "date": "2026-10-25T16:14:00+00:00",
   "id": "8ec45cfe56e665e5",
   "quote": "We’re seeing cases where the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "account": "Ravensgill Insurance",
   "date": "2026-09-04T09:00:00Z",
   "id": "95caadb2b08c2b23",
   "quote": "click \"Link to existing claim\", dead x1",
   "route": "sessions"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "accounts": [
   {
    "arr_gbp": 190000.0,
    "mentions": 2,
    "name": "Selsby Motor",
    "renewal_date": "2027-09-27"
   },
   {
    "arr_gbp": 290000.0,
    "mentions": 1,
    "name": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
    "renewal_date": "2027-01-09"
   },
   {
    "arr_gbp": 470000.0,
    "mentions": 1,
    "name": "Ravensgill Insurance",
    "renewal_date": "2027-04-30"
   }
  ],
  "accounts_n": 3,
  "arr_total_gbp": 950000.0,
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sessions": 3,
   "support": 1
  },
  "mentions_n": 4,
  "renewals_90d_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 2
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The brief states the three affected accounts represent a total ARR of 960000.0 GBP, but the fact sheet lists Selsby Motor at 190000.0, Tarnholt Drive Cover at 290000.0, and Ravensgill Insurance at 470000.0, summing to 950000.0 GBP — the brief's figure is 10000 GBP too high. Other claims (4 mentions, 3 accounts, 2 routes with 3 session and 1 support mention, 1 renewal in 90 days, dates, and quotes) match the cited insights and fact sheet. Because the ARR total is off the fact sheet, the brief overstates the financial impact.", "verdict": "fail"}
